# technitium_dns_record_rp (Resource)

Manages an RP (responsible person) record.

Records are matched by zone, name and `mailbox`, `txt_domain`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_dns_record_rp" "apex" {
  zone       = "example.com"
  name       = "@"
  mailbox    = "hostmaster@example.com"
  txt_domain = "contact.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mailbox` (String) Mailbox of the responsible person.
- `name` (String) Record name relative to the zone; `@` for the zone apex.
- `txt_domain` (String) Domain name of a TXT record with more information.
- `zone` (String) Authoritative zone the record belongs to.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments stored with the record.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the record is disabled (kept but not served).
- `expiry_ttl` (Number) Seconds after the last modification at which the server deletes the record; 0 disables expiry.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds. Defaults to the server's default record TTL. All records of one type at the same name form an RRset and share a single TTL, so give them the same value.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain name of the record.
- `id` (String) Record identifier and import ID: `<zone>/<name>/<mailbox> <txt_domain>`.

## Import

```shell
# <zone>/<name>/<mailbox> <txt_domain>
terraform import technitium_dns_record_rp.apex "example.com/@/hostmaster@example.com contact.example.com"
```
